select inbound.inbound_id as inboundId, inbound.prod_id as prodId, inbound.client_id as clientId, inbound.quantity as quantity, inbound.inbound_status as inboundStatus, inbound.req_inbound_date as reqInboundDate, inbound.ware_id as wareId, inbound.warehouse_pos_x as warehousePosX, inbound.warehouse_pos_y as warehousePosY, inbound.inbound_process_date as inboundProcessDate, product.prod_name as prodName, product.prod_price as prodPrice, product.prod_size as prodSize from inbound JOIN product ON inbound.prod_id = product.prod_id where inbound.inbound_status = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (inventory_id, prod_id, client_id, quantity, ware_id, last_inbound_date) SELECT #{inventoryId}, -- Java에서 생성한 UUID나 시퀀스 i.prod_id, i.client_id, i.quantity, #{wareId}, NOW() FROM inbound i WHERE i.prod_id = #{prodId} AND i.client_id = #{clientId}
mapper.select: SELECT inbound_id AS inboundId, prod_id as prodId, client_id as clientId, quantity as quantity, ware_id as wareId, inbound_status as inboundStatus, warehouse_pos_x as warehousePosX, warehouse_pos_y as warehousePosY, req_inbound_date as reqinboundDate, inbound_process_date as inboundProcessDate FROM inbound
mapper.update: UPDATE inbound SET inbound_status = 1, inbound_process_date = NOW() WHERE inbound_id = #{inboundId}

UPDATE inventory i JOIN inbound b ON i.client_id = b.client_id AND i.ware_id = b.ware_id AND i.warehouse_pos_x = b.warehouse_pos_x AND i.warehouse_pos_y = b.warehouse_pos_y AND i.prod_id = b.prod_id SET i.quantity = i.quantity + b.quantity, i.last_inbound_date = NOW() WHERE b.inbound_id = #{inboundId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory ( inventory_id, prod_id, client_id, quantity, ware_id, last_inbound_date, warehouse_pos_x, warehouse_pos_y ) SELECT CONCAT('INV-', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(FLOOR(RAND()*10000),4,'0')), b.prod_id, b.client_id, b.quantity, b.ware_id, NOW(), b.warehouse_pos_x, b.warehouse_pos_y FROM inbound b WHERE b.inbound_id = #{inboundId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory i WHERE i.client_id = b.client_id AND i.ware_id = b.ware_id AND i.warehouse_pos_x = b.warehouse_pos_x AND i.warehouse_pos_y = b.warehouse_pos_y AND i.prod_id = b.prod_id )
mapper.update: UPDATE userWareHouse uw JOIN inbound i ON uw.client_id = i.client_id AND uw.ware_id = i.ware_id AND uw.warehouse_pos_x = i.warehouse_pos_x AND uw.warehouse_pos_y = i.warehouse_pos_y JOIN product p ON i.prod_id = p.prod_id SET uw.warehouse_usage = IFNULL(uw.warehouse_usage, 0) + (i.quantity * p.prod_size) WHERE i.inbound_id = #{inboundId}
